dct_description_sm: ABR is involved in a long-term North Slope land rehabilitation program that includes preparing and implementing rehabilitation plans for facilitating the establishment of arctic wetland and upland plant communities on oil field disturbances. Attempts are being made to remediate areas disturbed by oil activities through revegetation with the intent to establish arctic wetland and upland habitats for wildlife. Soil and vegetation responses to the rehabilitation are being monitored.
dct_subject_sm: Social sciences, economics and policy -> Environment surveillance
dct_title_s: Ecological Restoration of Abandoned Oil Field Facilities and Exploration Well Sites in North Slope, Alaska
